cc:Work.dc:title: Test Accuracy
cc:Work.dc:description: Base and tuned accuracy on 27 questions: original: 18/27 and 18/27; neutral: 19/27 and 18/27; competing: 18/27 and 18/27; text only: 5/27 and 5/27. The accuracy axis covers 0–100%. Error bars are conditional 95% paired source/donor-cluster bootstrap accuracy intervals from 10,000 resamples of 10 supplied clusters.
